lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance clusters are organized in approximately five visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region, forming a structured grid-like distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with faint horizontal lines, creating a series of anchor nodes where circular high-luminance blobs are localized.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface displays a high-density distribution of small, irregularly spaced high-luminance spots that contrast with the organized grid pattern of the lateral flank.
